['create a MessengerBotChatOnboardWorld to handle onboarding for a chatbot model agent', 'create a MessengerBotChatTaskWorld to pair a user agent with a chatbot model', 'run the parley method in MessengerBotChatTaskWorld to exchange messages between agent and bot', 'create a MessengerOverworld to route agents between the overworld and chatbot task worlds', 'reset the chatbot dialogue history by sending a RESET command in the task world']
